## Root cause

The `default/app` Deployment (3 replicas, `nginx:1.31.5`) rolled a new ReplicaSet whose pod template was defective:

The cluster state was otherwise healthy: ReplicaSet `app-58b7cb8658` (the healthy template) had all 3 replicas Running/Ready, and no associated Service for `app`. There was no ConfigMap or RB needing a fix.

```
kubectl rollout undo deploy/app -n default --to-revision=1
```

Deployment fields (image, replicas: 3, resource limits/requests, strategy, selector) were left untouched.

- `kubectl rollout status`: `deployment "app" successfully rolled out`
